origin.elemental_eyes.toad_sage.name: Toad Sage (Test)
origin.elemental_eyes.toad_sage.descript: A durable fighter with longer melee reach and enough jump strength to clear a two-block obstacle.
power.elemental_eyes.toad_oil.name: Toad Oil
power.elemental_eyes.toad_oil.descriptio: Primary Active: Spray oil forward. Oiled targets ignite when hit by FIRE. The special burn lasts 5 seconds after the last FIRE hit and ignores Fire Resistance. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
power.elemental_eyes.toad_fire.name: Flame Spray
power.elemental_eyes.toad_fire.descripti: Secondary Active: Slow slightly and breathe a wide cone of flame for about 1 second. Damages targets while they remain in the cone and ignites oiled targets. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
